component.name: Big Storage Rescue
component.summary: Diagnose drives and rescue files from them
Diagnostique unidades e resgate arquivos delas

description.p: Big Storage Rescue explains what is wrong with a storage device and helps to save the files on it, without writing to the device that is failing.

ul.li: Shows every drive with its health (SMART and NVMe), including drives that are not mounted
Explains why a device cannot be written to: Windows Fast Startup, filesystem errors, write protection, permissions
Shows which programs keep a device busy, and removes it safely without forcing anything
Copies files off a failing disk with real progress, pause and resume, also after a power cut
Makes a disk image with GNU ddrescue, finds lost partitions with TestDisk and files by content with PhotoRec
Every tool also works in the terminal, through SSH, with JSON output for scripts

description.p: O Big Storage Rescue explica o que há de errado com um dispositivo de armazenamento e ajuda a salvar os arquivos dele, sem gravar no dispositivo que está falhando.

First release as an application of its own. The drive manager, file rescue, diagnosis and safe removal of Big-Mount 2.6 now live here; Big-Mount only mounts internal partitions at boot. Copies started in Big-Mount are brought over and can be resumed.
